termTips.readiness: Readiness = average % correct across skills in your latest test — an estimate of how ready you are for the real exam.
termTips.task: Task = a short practice round on one topic. Score at or above the threshold % to pass it.
termTips.passThreshold: Pass threshold: the minimum % of correct answers in one practice round to pass the task.

syllabus.title: Syllabus
syllabus.subtitle: I’m just starting and haven’t taken any test
syllabus.desc: Work through every topic in each section in order. Take a mock exam later to get a more precise plan.

diagnosis.title: Test results
diagnosis.subtitle: Diagnose my weak spots

noTarget.syllabus: You haven’t set a target for "{exam}", so pass thresholds use the default level for now. Go ahead, create a plan and start studying; once you set a target, click Update to new target and the plan applies the right thresholds while keeping your progress.

form.pickTest: Choose a test to build the plan from

steps.heading: How it works
steps.step1SyllabusDesc: No test needed — the plan follows the exam’s syllabus.
steps.step1DiagnosisDesc: We diagnose your weak spots from this test.
steps.step2Desc: Each stage is one exam section, with several short tasks by topic.
steps.step3Title: Pass tasks, then take a mock exam
steps.step3Desc: Once all tasks are passed, take a mock exam to recheck and update your plan.

generate.targetAchieved: You’ve reached your target (readiness {readiness}%), no new plan needed. You can set a higher target in the Target tab, or keep taking mock exams to stay in shape.

confirmReplace.title: Replace your current plan?
confirmReplace.message: You’re currently on Plan {sequence} ({passed}/{total} tasks passed). Creating a new plan will replace it; the old plan stays saved with the status "Replaced" and you can switch back later.

planList.targetOutdatedTitle: This plan was created for an old target; update it to apply your current target’s thresholds
planList.resyncTitle: Update pass thresholds to your current target, keeping passed tasks
planList.cannotDeleteActive: You can’t delete the plan in progress

switchModal.title: Switch study plan
switchModal.message: Switch to Plan {sequence}? Your current plan will be saved with the status "Replaced".

deleteModal.title: Delete study plan
deleteModal.message: Are you sure you want to delete Plan {sequence}? All its task and session data will be permanently lost.

cheer.waiting: Your plan is waiting for its first task.
cheer.firstTask: Pass your first task today to kick off your plan.
cheer.allDone: You’ve passed every task — time for a mock exam to lock in your results!
cheer.almost: Only {remaining, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}} left to finish the plan. Bring it home!
cheer.halfway: You’re past the halfway mark — {remaining, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}} to go.
cheer.momentum: {passed, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}} passed, you’re on a roll. Keep it up with one task a day.

detail.replaced: This plan has been replaced by a newer one.

detail.targetOutdatedNoSource: This plan was created for an old target — pass thresholds don’t reflect your current target yet. Update it now, no retake needed — progress on passed tasks is kept.

detail.roadmapDesc: {parts, plural, one {# stage} other {# stages}} · {tasks, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}}

mockGuide.heading: What’s next?
mockGuide.intro: You’ve finished the practice tasks. Two more steps to close the learning loop:
mockGuide.step1Desc: A full mock exam re-measures your real readiness after practice, more accurately than practicing sections one by one.
mockGuide.step2Title: Create a new plan from that test
mockGuide.step2Desc: We re-diagnose your weak spots from the new test and build your next plan. Repeat until you hit your target.
mockGuide.freshMock: You have a newly completed test:
mockGuide.practiceNote: (section practice test — the plan will only cover the sections practiced)
mockGuide.afterSubmit: After you submit a mock exam, come back here — the Create plan from this test button will be ready so you don’t have to look for it.

history.notFound: This task wasn’t found in the study plan.
history.noSessions: No practice rounds for this task yet.

compare.title: Compare study plans
compare.emptyTitle: Not enough plans to compare yet
compare.emptyDescription: You need at least {min} plans for this exam. Take another mock exam and create a new plan to compare.

compareCharts.chartDesc: Horizontal axis: plan order (1 → latest). Bars = starting readiness when the plan was created from a mock exam.
compareCharts.note: Blue = in progress · green = completed · gray = replaced · red = abandoned. The starting point doesn’t change as you pass tasks — only a new mock exam + a new plan raise readiness.
